verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The market empties out and the pigeons take the square.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Someone's dropped bread near the fountain, still warm
crumbs holding the shape of a hand

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A gull settles on the rim, waiting its turn --
even the water seems to pause
before it lets the light back in

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Dusk folds the square into itself,
one bird still watching the last of the crumbs
disappear like a held breath, finally let go

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A lamp flickers on above the empty stones,
the pigeons gone to wherever pigeons go --
only the fountain keeps talking to itself

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone leans on the rail, listening for meaning
finds only water, repeating what it's always said

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the words dissolve before they're fully spoken --
still, he stays, learning the shape of that old sentence

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
cold seeps up through his shoes, patient as the water --
some lessons the body learns before the mind agrees

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
he shifts his weight, checks his phone, still stays --
some vigils keep themselves long past their reason

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a light comes on across the water, then another --
he counts them like a man counting reasons to leave

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
he never gets past three or four --
some arithmetic was never meant to add up clean

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the fifth light flickers, unsure of itself --
he decides to call that one a sign instead

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the sixth light doesn't come, and he lets it not --
some signs are just the dark agreeing with him

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the water keeps its own dark counsel too --
he stops naming lights, starts calling them company

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
he leaves a chair out for the company --
the porch settles, taking its own slow census

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning counts the chair as still occupied --
he doesn't correct it, lets the mistake keep him
